name: PersuasionBench
description: PersuasionBench is a large-scale benchmark and arena designed to measure the persuasiveness of generative language models automatically. It includes a battery of tasks to evaluate how well models generate persuasive language, investigating linguistic patterns and the impact of model size and training on persuasiveness.
reputation: A recent benchmark/arena for measuring model persuasiveness, with growing interest but not yet a widely standardized community benchmark.
notes: Includes PersuasionArena for community contributions; highlights societal implications of AI-driven persuasion.
